{{Quote|Jedi, eh? Well Empire Day is the day the Emperor declared them outlaws, so it might be worth getting that information out there as soon as possible.|An Imperial data officer speaking of an imprisoned Jedi|<ref name="SWG:HED" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual served as an '''Imperial [[data officer]]''' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[data officer]] was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] stationed in the [[Science Outpost]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:HED" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, he met an Imperial spacer, sent to meet him from [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] by an [[Unidentified Imperial garrison historian|Imperial garrison historian]]. The data officer had the Imperial meet up with an [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Yavin 4)|Imperial commander]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] so that he could complete his mission concerning an [[Jedi Prisoner|imprisoned Jedi]].<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Thankfully the Emperor was able to see them (the Jedi) for their true colors. His courage is why I became a Soldier for the Empire.|An Imperial data officer speaking of the Emperor's courage|<ref name="SWG:HED" />}}
The Imperial data officer was very loyal to the Empire and its [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. He, like [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], believed that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were what sickened the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The data officer admired Palpatine's courage in [[Order 66/Legends|declaring the Jedi as outlaws]]. It was for this reason that he joined the Empire.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Behind the scenes==
An Imperial data officer, who lacked an official name, appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial data officer was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> he could be found in the Science Outpost and was part of a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Happy Empire Day!|Happy Empire Day!]]," which sent players on an important mission throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:HED" /> After the live event ended, the Imperial data officer never reappeared in the game since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
